alex: Hey team — short notice: flying out tomorrow early AM, need someone to cover my Sun 20:00-23:00 UTC oncall block (EU evening). Leaving a concise handoff below, happy to sync until 19:30 UTC.

alex: Handoff notes:
- Service: inference-api (production)
- Quick checks: /api/health, look at tokenizer-error metric + tail latency in Grafana (latency >300ms = escalate).
- Prewarm: start rw-small-v2 prewarm at 19:50 (see command).
- Fallback: if CPU/GPU pressure spikes, route to rw-small-v2 (override header X-Model-Force: rw-small-v2).
- Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-api-oncall (credentials in vault).

alex: Helpful commands (one-liners):
```
# inflight requests
curl -s https://internal-metrics/api/inflight | jq '.inflight'
# prewarm model
curl -X POST https://inference-api/v1/models/rw-small-v2/prewarm -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN' -d '{"concurrency":4}'
```

maria: I can cover 20:00-23:00 UTC. Will prewarm at 19:50 and shadow for 15m. :thumbsup:

sam: I can overlap 21:30-22:30 UTC if you want a quick pair handoff or escalation overlap.

priya: FYI infra has a planned rolling cache flush Sun 21:00-21:15 (ENG-4321). I'll flag to postpone if Maria wants.

alex: Thanks Maria — two quick notes: 1) check KV cache hitrate >80% (Grafana link in runbook), 2) if you see request queueing, reduce batch_size in the route config or fail to rw-small-v2.

maria: Ack. I'll monitor cache hitrate and tail latency. Contact: maria (GMT+1) — DM or call if spike. I'll open a short channel thread if anything starts bubbling.

devops-bot: Noted maintenance window ENG-4321 scheduled Sun 21:00-21:15 UTC. Devops oncall available to postpone on request. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll take it as-is and coordinate if we need to pause the flush. I'll also drop a short prewarm test at 19:55 to confirm warm pools.

alex: Perfect — rota updated: maria covers 20:00-23:00 UTC. I'm reachable until 19:30 for handoff. Leaving the minimal quick checklist here so it's easy to find. Really appreciate the cover, team. :pray:
